The '''Gold Crescent''' was an award given out by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for serving with merit during the [[Galactic War]]. After the capture of General [[Arkos Rakton]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|commander]] of [[Havoc Squad]] was awarded the [[Cross of Glory]], while the rest of the squadmembers each received a Gold Crescent.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gold Crescent is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission on Coruscant.<ref name="SWTOR" />
